text:
Maya: Quick sync on small-multiples chart UX. Items: legend density, axis unit toggles, smoothing placement, outlier badges, and color contrast on thin lines. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/small-multiples/metrics-v2

Priya: Accessibility first: thin 1px lines with low contrast fail our WCAG checks at small sizes. Need >=3:1 for non-text UI. Suggest increasing stroke weight slightly or using darker palette options behind a "high contrast" toggle.

Ken: For legend density, current compact mode shows just swatches and initials (e.g., "DB", "API"). Works visually but ambiguous. Proposal: keep swatch + 3-char abbrev plus tooltip with full name. On hover or keyboard focus reveal full label.

Ali: Axis units: auto-scaling to K / M is common but can confuse non-technical PMs. Idea: show full unit in tooltip and small postfix text below axis: e.g., "Values (requests per min)" and inline label on axis ticks use compact form. Also add a toggle in chart options: [Auto units] / [Raw numbers].

Maya: Outliers: product wants to avoid axis explosion. My mock shows a tiny "+n" badge pinned to top-right of chart when points lie outside current y-scale. Clicking expands axis. UX question: should badge be visible when 0 outliers? Probably hide when none.

Priya: A11y for badge: make it a button with aria-pressed state and aria-label like "3 outlier points excluded from scale. Press Enter to include." Ensure it's in tab order after legend controls.

Ken: Smoothing control: users confuse smoothing with sampling. Suggest putting smoothing into advanced chart menu (three-dot menu) and add a one-line tooltip: "Smooth lines to emphasize trend; may distort peaks." Default OFF for latency and throughput charts.

Ali: Small-multiples layout: when panels are narrow, legends must be per-panel or global? Data shows users prefer global legend for scanning across panels. Let's keep a single top-level legend with per-panel focus highlight on hover.

Priya: Keyboard interactions recap:
- Legend items: focusable, Enter toggles visibility, Arrow keys navigate.
- Outlier badge: focusable, Enter toggles inclusion.
- Unit toggles: accessible via chart settings with aria-controls to update axis labels.
- Announcements: use aria-live polite for state changes, but coalesce messages to avoid spam.

Ken: Implementation notes:
- Reuse existing Tooltip and Popover components.
- Add higher-contrast stroke tokens in theme.
- formatNumberAccessible for aria-labels: e.g., visual "1.2K" -> aria "1,200 requests per minute".

Maya: Decision proposal:
1) Increase minimum stroke to 1.5px for thin-line palette and add theme toggle for high-contrast.
2) Legend: compact swatch + 3-char abbrev with tooltip; full names on focus/hover.
3) Units: show verbose unit label under axis, compact ticks, toggle in settings.
4) Outliers: show "+n" badge when >0, focusable button to expand axis, default excluded for overview dashboards.
5) Smoothing: move to advanced menu, default off for perf charts.

Can design + eng approve these changes?

Ali: Approved from PM side. Will update acceptance criteria: include keyboard tests and aria-live checks.

Ken: I'll add formatNumberAccessible and high-contrast tokens in the PR.

Priya: I'll write the microcopy and QA checklist (including screenreader samples). Example announcement strings: "Legend collapsed, 4 series. Press Enter to open." and "Three outlier points excluded from scale."

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll push updated figma frames and mock interactions. We'll iterate after the first prototype.
